Here is a summary:

**Root cause:** In `_cstack` (the function handling the `&` operator), when `right` is already an ndarray (i.e., a pre-computed separability matrix from a nested `CompoundModel`), the code was incorrectly assigning the scalar `1` to the relevant block of `cright`, making every element in that block equal to 1. This caused all outputs of the right-side sub-model to appear dependent on all its inputs, destroying separability information that had already been computed.

**Fix:** Change `= 1` to `= right` so the actual computed matrix values are copied into the correct position in the combined matrix instead of being overwritten with all-ones.

The analogous code for `left` already did this correctly (`cleft[: left.shape[0], : left.shape[1]] = left`), so the fix makes `right` consistent with `left`.
